description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This is a confidential opportunity for a visionary leader passionate about delivering exceptional patient care and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff.In this pivotal role, you will oversee all aspects of facility management, ensuring compliance with state and federal regulations while driving operational excellence and financial performance. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in skilled nursing facility administration, a commitment to quality improvement, and the ability to inspire and manage a diverse team.This full-time position offers a highly competitive salary package, reflecting the importance of this leadership role. Join a facility committed to making a significant impact on the lives of its residents and the professional growth of its team.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland
Proven experience in skilled nursing facility administration and operations management
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations governing long-term care facilities
Demonstrated leadership abilities with a focus on quality care and team development
Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration or a related field preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000 annually, based on experience.

description:
Join a premier community health clinic in Greenville, SC, seeking a dedicated Med-Peds Physician. This is an exceptional opportunity to provide comprehensive care in a supportive environment, offering a highly competitive compensation package and robust benefits.

The role features a non-negotiable base salary of $210,000, complemented by a guaranteed $25,000 bonus and an additional $25,000 in potential bonuses. A $9,000 sign-on/relocation bonus is available on your first payday upon signing a promissory note. Enjoy great benefits, including generous paid time off, in a role that values your expertise and commitment to patient care.
requirements: Doctor of Medicine (MD) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO) degree
Board Certification or Eligibility in Internal Medicine-Pediatrics, Family Medicine, or Internal Medicine
Active South Carolina medical license or eligibility for licensure
Commitment to providing comprehensive patient care across all age groups
salaryOrBonusInfo: This position offers a non-negotiable base salary of $210,000 per year. The compensation package includes a guaranteed $25,000 bonus and an additional $25,000 in potential bonuses, totaling up to $50,000 in incentives. A $9,000 sign-on/relocation bonus is provided on the first payday upon signing a promissory note. Total annual compensation can reach up to $260,000.
